title: Mama Bird Box Alternatives: 4 Pregnancy Gift Boxes - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for boxes like Mama Bird Box? Compare four pregnancy boxes by price, timing, and contents, from due-date boxes to prepaid gifts.
body_markdown:
Month to month, no commitment


### Bump Boxes vs Mama Bird Box


**Best for:** The buyer who wants a large, established pregnancy box with a no-commitment monthly plan or a prepaid gift.


[Bump Boxes](https://bumpboxes.com/) sends five to eight products a month that it screens for pregnancy safety, themed to the trimester: nausea care and keepsakes early on, belly butter and bump support in the middle, then labor, postpartum, and newborn items at the end. The first box comes with a free welcome gift. Gift buyers can prepay six, nine, or 12 months for $250, $350, or $450.[My Subscription Addiction](https://www.mysubscriptionaddiction.com/best-pregnancy-subscription-boxes) has named it the top pregnancy box year after year.


#### What feels familiar


Contents that track the pregnancy, plus prepaid gift terms, both part of the Mama Bird Box formula.


#### What changes


The 6-, 9-, and 12-month plans bill monthly, carry a $25 fee to cancel early, and keep renewing unless you cancel at least 30 days before the term ends. Once the baby arrives, the subscription switches to Bitsy Boxes, its mom-and-baby box. Prepaid gifts don't renew.
